examples.title: Recommend from Trakt
examples.input_or_trigger: Use Trakt to recommend three thoughtful science-fiction movies.
prerequisites: Install the plugin or the named standalone skill, and separately enable the Companion for Trakt connection. Skills alone do not supply tools or authenticate the server.
examples.expected_behavior: Select Trakt recommendations with supported genre filters and explain the returned metadata. If asked for recommendations based on all viewing or unseen titles, first traverse every relevant watched-summary page; for recent viewing use the latest 100 events per medium. Report partial coverage and do not imply streaming availability.

examples.title: Summarize watched history

prerequisites: Install the plugin or the named standalone skill, and separately enable the Companion for Trakt connection. Skills alone do not supply tools or authenticate the server.
examples.expected_behavior: Traverse movie and show summary streams separately, following every next_page until each reports has_more: false and next_page: null. Preserve supplied metadata and report partial coverage with a resume page if either stream is incomplete; do not infer viewing hours, streaks, or completion of a show from its summary.

examples.expected_behavior: Search by title and medium, compare returned years and identifiers, and ask which match is intended if the results remain ambiguous. Ordinary lookup stays bounded; an explicit all-results request follows every page.

examples.title: Reconnect a Trakt account

claude-code.notes: Install the repository marketplace or add the remote MCP server, then authenticate through the client's MCP controls. For skill use, natural language or /trakt-mcp:what-to-watch is documented; /mcp manages the server connection, not skill invocation.

claude-desktop.notes: Install from the repository marketplace or add the remote connector, then connect the user's own Trakt account.

claude-web.notes: Add the remote connector where the account and organization permit it; enable it for the conversation.

claude-cowork.notes: Install plugin skills and connect the remote MCP tools where account and organization policy permit.

codex-cli.notes: Add the marketplace plugin or remote HTTP server, start a new session, and complete OAuth login. Use natural language or the skill picker where available; the repository does not document an exact Codex skill invocation here.

chatgpt-web.notes: A personal developer-mode MCP connection is documented where workspace policy permits; this is not a public directory listing or approval.

trakt.description: The native trakt MCP server is a multi-user Rust/WASM service on Cloudflare Workers. Its tools read viewing history, recommendations, titles, lists, and calendars, or make explicitly requested changes with write permission. Each person authorizes their own Trakt account through client OAuth and device approval. Existing tokens and standalone device login remain read-only; client OAuth reauthorization is required for write scope. The server supplies tools; standalone skills supply workflow instructions and require this connection.
